gate_ga_full_evidence_selection_incumben.plan_reference: Stage A: Gate GA-full is required before Stage D.

original_broad_gate_gc_learning_efficien.interpretation: Stage C6 established reduced nuisance drift, but broadcast learned the causal target faster. A Stage D transfer test must therefore measure the drift-versus-learning-speed tradeoff rather than assume ReDCO dominance.

budget.disposition: Preserve the balance. Do not launch Stage D before the incumbent, judge, and preregistered ledgers exist.

next_cpu_work: Port the evidence-selection incumbent into a verifiers environment without adding ReDCO.
Pin and audit a local greedy judge, including exact prompt and retry semantics.
Reproduce the incumbent learning-curve shape before adding a ReDCO arm.
Freeze total generated tokens as the primary learning constraint and GPU-hours as the headline scale constraint.
Keep nuisance drift and calls-to-threshold as separate primary outcomes; do not create a post-hoc composite.

next_live_gate.name: GA-full evidence-selection incumbent reproduction
next_live_gate.allowed_after: Environment tests, judge reproducibility tests, ledger audit, and a frozen preregistration pass.
